visual.general_description: Black-and-white bordered two-column table presenting a day-by-day hospital course, headed by day labels, with bold and italic text in the right column.
visual.detailed_description: A white background carries a bordered table of 23 rows and two columns, with no header row, title, axes, legend or arrows. The narrow left column holds day labels (D1, D6, D7, D8-D12, D12-D14, D15, D16, D17, D18, D20, D21, D22, D23, D24, D25, D29, D32, D33, D35-D43, D43, D45, then the labels 5 days later and 3 Months after discharge). The wider right column holds short text in regular, bold and italic type. Row D1 reads Agitation, disorganized behavior, then bold Dysarthria, confusion followed by Admission. Row D6 has bold Perioral dyskinesia, memory problems, then hallucinations followed by Risperidone 8 mg. Row D7 has italic 1st EEG: Artefacts, no epileptic discharges, then CPK levels at 2459 U/L. Row D8-D12 has bold Loss of consciousness, then Chlorpromazine and Diazepam stopped and CPK 1430 U/L. Row D12-D14 has bold Catatonia developed followed by Mutism, stupor, rigidity, posturing, catalepsy: AP stopped, with a second line ECT done on D14. Row D15 has italic 2nd EEG: General slowing of basal rhythm, no epileptic discharges, then Normal non injected cCTS, with a bold second line Epileptic seizures. Row D16 has bold Pneumonia, unstable vitals, then italic CSF analysis: Increased IgG index. No infection, no tumor cells. Search for IgG anti-NMDAR Abs started. Row D17 has italic 3rd EEG: Extreme Delta Brush aspect, bold IV Corticosteroids and AC: VA, and italic Testicular echography: Normal. Row D18 reads GTCS. Row D20 reads Transfer to neurology ward. Row D21 has bold Corticosteroids end. Row D22 has italic 4th EEG: Extreme Delta Brush aspect persists. Row D23 has bold PP sessions start. Row D24 reads Epilepsy remains: CMZ added. Row D25 reads 3rd PP session: Start of clinical response. Row D29 reads VEEG: Epilepsy confirmed, CNZ added to previous AC. Row D32 has bold End of plasmapheresis. Row D33 reads Seizures: Levetiracetam added to AC. Row D35-D43 reads ICU transfer and stay: Intubation after nosocomial pneumonia, antibiotics then extubating. No complications. Row D43 reads Retransfer to neurology. Patient alert, cooperative well oriented, no dysarthria, symmetric and reactive pupils. Row D45 reads End of hospitalization. Row 5 days later has italic Positive IgG anti-NMDAR Abs in CSF. Row 3 Months after discharge has italic 5th EEG: Normal. The image is low resolution; all text was legible at 3x magnification.
